text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was to run in the Japan 
Cup. Just as expected, Kitasan Black was 
there too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Tokai Teio as well. The one Kitasan 
Black looked up to, and Mejiro McQueen's 
great rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Satono Diamond and the others would 
challenge Tokai Teio!
